scientific_integrity: Universal conclusions follow from explicit subgroup-orthogonality block proof. Finite exact and numerical computations serve as corroboration only. No external independent audit has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to centered valuation shells of finite cyclic prime-power groups. It does not address general masks, noncyclic groups or p-adic continuum operators. An equivalent historical formulation may exist; historical novelty is not independently certified.
title: Exact Fourier concentration spectrum between valuation shells on \(\mathbb Z/p^n\mathbb Z\)
